units.source_text: 这储藏室内设备甚不周全，只有藏香的柜子和橱子等物而已。

en.t: The storeroom was very poorly furnished, containing only cabinets and cupboards for storing incense and the like.

units.source_text: 把这些东西堆放到两边角落里，加以布置，使宜于居住，公主就住在这里面。

en.t: These things were piled into the corners on either side and arranged to make the place fit to live in, and the princess stayed there.

units.source_text: 室内阴暗，但早晨日出之时，亦有阳光射入。

en.t: The room was dim, but in the morning, when the sun rose, sunlight still came streaming in.

units.source_text: 公主偶然解下裹在头上的衣服，用手整理散乱的头发，夕雾便得隐约窥见姿色。

en.t: When the princess happened to remove the garment wrapped around her head and smoothed her disheveled hair with her hands, Yugiri was able to glimpse her beauty faintly.

units.source_text: 他觉得这是一个上品的女子，容颜十分娇艳。

en.t: He felt that she was a woman of the highest refinement, with an exquisitely lovely face.

units.source_text: 夕雾的姿态，放任不拘的时候反比一本正经的时候优美得多。

en.t: Yugiri's bearing was far more graceful when he was relaxed and unrestrained than when he was formal and proper.

units.source_text: 落叶公主看了，想道：“我的故夫相貌并不优异，然而非常自傲，有时嫌我容颜欠美呢。

en.t: Princess Ochiba looked at him and thought, "My late husband was not especially handsome, yet he was very proud and at times found fault with my face for lacking beauty.

units.source_text: 何况我现在衰减得如此厉害，教这美男子看了，恐怕一刻也不能忍受吧。”

en.t: And now that I have declined so terribly, if this handsome man were to see me, he probably could not bear it for even a moment."

units.source_text: 左思右想，自我劝慰一番。

en.t: She turned the matter over in her mind and tried for a while to console herself.

units.source_text: 但总觉得不胜痛苦：各方面的人闻知了定然怪我，使我罪无可逭。

en.t: But she still felt unbearably distressed: if people in every quarter heard of it, they would surely blame her, leaving her with no escape from guilt.

units.source_text: 况且身在丧服之中，更加令人痛心，实在难于自慰。

en.t: Moreover, being still in mourning made it all the more heartbreaking, and she truly found it hard to comfort herself.
